events.author: Velociryx
events.name: A More Disciplined Approach

options.text: A dark day indeed. The nation weeps for our lost sons and daughters.
As grim as these tidings are, we must bear up and ensure that it never happens again. That starts at the top. We need more discipline and training, across the board.

events.text: A dark day for the Realm. The unit led by [character] was ambushed and destroyed. There were no survivors.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Arrow to the Eye
events.text: [character] [unit] see the incoming attack from the [rival] forces too late. After the first volley of missiles [character] lies wounded, one eye torn from the face by a wayward arrow or shrapnel of rock. Although the General survives, within days sight has fled from the other eye, leaving him unable to see.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Emergency War Taxes

options.text: Grim news indeed. Our nation mourns the loss.
A dark bit of news, but we must be pragmatic here. Let us use this tragedy to drive patriotic fervor and levy some new taxes, giving us resources to respond with.

events.text: A dark report from the frontier. Recently, a force commanded by [character] was waylaid and utterly destroyed. Sadly, there were no survivors.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Enough Missiles to Block the Sun

options.text: A tragedy indeed. The nation mourns his loss, and the loss of our brave soldiers.
Let us rally our troops with an impassioned speech from the steps of the palace. We shall avenge him!

events.text: During a recent battle, [character] was killed in action, and the unit he led was lost entirely. According to reports, his unit was hit with a volley of missiles so intense that, for a moment, they blotted out the sun…

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Felled by Arrows

options.text: Pay your respects to the [family] family.
Vow to repay the [rival] armies with your own ranged might.

events.text: The soldiers mourn as [character] body is carried back from the field of battle, the brave General slain by the rain of missiles.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Learning From Our Mistakes

options.text: A bitter pill indeed. The nation mourns such a catastrophic loss.
This was an expensive lesson, but we must study the tactics of our foes to keep this from happening again.

events.text: Grim tidings! The unit [character] was leading was attacked recently and he was killed. To make matters worse, we lost the entire unit as well!

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Taking the Reins

options.text: This is a dark day in our nation’s history. The nation mourns.
A change is in order. I shall take a more direct hand in military affairs to help ensure this never happens again.

events.text: Our forces recently suffered a catastrophic loss. In a surprise attack, [character] was killed, and his entire unit was lost…
